activity_summary: At rehearsal the tally stayed at twenty-four lines, with nothing added and no song. You told them not to shorten the loss of the wife. You are idle from the opening until the end. No one brought a price from the Theatre into the parlour. The Sunday letter stayed at the lodging for the Bell after the play.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Held the tally at twenty-four and the wife's loss at its own pace.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Added nothing in rehearsal and refused to be thanked for a song he had not given.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Refused a clever wait, and left the Theatre's price with his father.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Brought Monday's margin and would not add the days up a second time for pleasure.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Do not shorten the wife

facets.activity: Kept the tally at twenty-four lines

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Do not shorten the wife to save the wait.
